snippet.title: Who Are You! Episode 2 - World Premiere Trailer | Harvest of Terror 2026
snippet.description:
"👽 Who Are You!? is a psychological horror game based on real UFO research and inspired by the alien phenomenon. Play as Ray Roswell, a man searching for answers after the disappearance of his wife, only to find strange connections to UFO sightings, alien encounters, and unexplained events. Question what is real and discover how close the phenomenon may be.

🚨Play Episode 1 here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2646450/Who_Are_You/

🔑 For Streamers/Content Creators/News Outlets, request your key: https://app.pressengine.net/requestkey/whoareyou"
---
Originally aired during HARVEST OF TERROR: a Horror Game Awards Showcase on Wednesday 7 October 2026.
---
Set up by two die hard horror game fans, the aim of The Horror Game Awards is simple: to celebrate horror as one of the best genres in video games and to recognise the year’s greatest horror games alongside the developers who make them.
